cameratools_first_person_label: First person view on closest zoom
cameratools_hide_map_markers_label: Disable map markers with hidden UI
cameratools_update_notification:
- Added free camera for screenshots with hidden HUD.
- Added first-person view at the closest zoom (indoors and open-world).
- Added follow camera option while walking.
- Added smoother vehicle zoom and bumper view.
- Fixed hiding the HUD now also hides notifications.
- Improved performance during sleep and fast-forward.

Open Options > Mods > Camera Tools to configure the cameras.
cameratools_free_camera_controls_hint: Free camera: WASD move, Q/E up/down, Shift faster. R returns near your character; Esc exits.
cameratools_first_person_controls_hint: First person: Move the mouse to look. Right-click toggles the cursor; scroll out to leave this view.
